corpora.name: confirmation
notes: per-sequence wall time is recorded in metrics.sequenceWallMs (index = sequence seed)
hostile probes: 1 illegal event per step at p=0.35 + the full probe set every 11th step
deep freeze audit: every step shallow, depth-first on a 1-in-17 sample

corpora.name: tally
notes: ledger assembled directly (valid; the production ledger barrier re-verifies every record); control sample drives every event
tie-break pool includes the UTF-16/UTF-8 divergence pairs (U+1F600 vs U+FFFF, U+10FFFF vs U+FFFF)
ledger sizes: skewed 2..50 (median 5, mean ~12) with forced 2/3/49/50 boundaries

corpora.name: merkle
notes: proof policy: ALL proofs for n <= 500, >= 10% evenly strided for n > 500
tamper matrix applied to every 10th verified proof (path flip/truncate/extend, wrong index, wrong leaf)

corpora.name: validator
notes: group signature cached per distinct message (4096 group signs, 4096-combo pool); every event has its own publisher signature and validation

matrix rows exercised: accept, accept-option-shape, attempt-content-divergence, batch-pin-mismatch, dispute-missing-tag, dispute-verdict-forgery, epoch-content-divergence, epoch-malformed, epoch-pin-mismatch, market-content-divergence, market-too-long, message-substitution, missing-epoch-tag, missing-signers-tag, nonce-mismatch, outcome-content-divergence, outcome-too-long, round-content-divergence, round-too-long, sig-truncated, sig-wrong-signer, signer-set-size-mismatch, signers-content-divergence, signers-malformed, signers-pin-mismatch, threshold-content-divergence, threshold-pin-mismatch, threshold-zero, tier-content-divergence, tier-out-of-range, tier-pin-mismatch, untrusted-publisher, wrong-group-key, wrong-kind
all keys are derived from the campaign seed (sha256 labels) — the run is reproducible, no CSPRNG

corpora.name: selection
notes: roster sizes: log-uniform 3..500, with 3/4/499/500 forced first in every run
deep checks (determinism, verifyJurySelection, independent ranking) on every 50th draw
chi-square: 100000 single-winner trials over an 8-juror weighted pool (df=7, p=0.001)

corpora.name: encoding
notes: field mixes of 1..8 fields over u8/u32/u64/text/hex/bytes with boundary and unicode values
injectivity + prefix-freeness checks on every 10th encoding

loadNote: Measured in ONE invocation on a 16-core host at load average ~19. The same corpus took 18.7 min of corpus wall time earlier the same night under load average 30-50: wall times here are host-dependent, every counter/size/failure count is not. If a host cannot finish the corpus in one invocation, run it as documented splits with --only/--merge into the same artifact.
